small_lambda_model.setup: q is an odd alpha-reservoir prime with q|P and q not selected into A; m=v_q(P)>=1; q divides none of B,C,D,M,D0,Q; lambda=P/M has v_q(lambda)=m
small_lambda_model.stage36_V_input: Legendre(2,q)=+1, hence q is 1 or 7 modulo 8
small_lambda_model.valuation_coordinate: k=-v_q(t) for pole sectors; finite sectors have v_q(t)>=0
small_lambda_model.finite_positive_sector: v_q(t)>0 is realizable exactly when K=R=d=+1
small_lambda_model.finite_unit_sector: v_q(t)=0 is realizable exactly when K=R=+1 and there exists y in F_q minus {0,+1,-1} with Legendre(y,q)=d and Legendre(1-y,q)=Legendre(1+y,q)=d
small_lambda_model.intermediate_pole_sector: 1<=k<m exists only when m>=2 and is realizable exactly when epsilon=K=R=+1
small_lambda_model.tie_sector: k=m is realizable exactly when epsilon*K=R=+1 and there exists y in F_q minus {0,+1,-1} with Legendre(y,q)=d, Legendre(1-y,q)=epsilon, Legendre(1+y,q)=+1
small_lambda_model.deep_pole_sector: k>m is realizable exactly when epsilon*K=R=d=+1
small_lambda_model.completeness: the five sectors exhaust v_q(t) relative to 0 and -m; each condition is the exact odd-q valuation parity plus normalized residue criterion, so their disjunction is necessary and sufficient for a Q_q point on the four-square branch model at this unused P-prime
small_lambda_model.point_independent: the finite-field existential depends only on q and the branch characters K,R,d, not on a putative receiver point

M_side_adapter.setup: q|M and q not selected into B
M_side_adapter.change_of_coordinate: use w=u/v and lambda'=M/P; then the model is the same small-lambda model with A'=B, B'=A, kappa'=-kappa, rho'=rho

unused_alpha_filter.rule: for every odd q|P not dividing A, apply the five-sector small-lambda criterion; for every odd q|M not dividing B, apply the M-side transformed criterion
unused_alpha_filter.selected_alpha_primes: remain governed by the audited/provisional CC selected-alpha row and are not retested here

failure_support: unused q=73 on the P side
unused q=7 on the M side
